notes.title: 🦎 Lizards Lore in "Lizards Must Die 2"
notes.content:
You need to know the enemy by sight. In Russ vs Lizards 2, lizards aren't just idiots with iron sticks. They are idiots who have grenades, tanks and cunning leaders.

During the 8-year-old Second Hyperborean War, the lizards destroyed the lands of Russia. We will tell you more about their history and strategy. After the first invasion, they received technology from their secret allies, the reptilians, and now they have swords, axes, dynamite, tanks, airships, and lizard battleships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/bcf0eff6d5841e1f9a63544ca32ed0f62bd8b64e.png[/img]

Using the slave labor of captured dinosaurs and smaller lizards, the bolder and larger lizards quickly learned how to establish a business and built factories and slums in the Rus lands, both to extract valuable resources and simply to pollute the entire area. They are lizards, after all - it's part of their nature to disrupt beautiful nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/20d9e91a42f35f47fc3d5d237f9c4cfd42b59617.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/4195d2f9894b574aef03f2ec2028d5d81aed25d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/fc16c6fa6d8779a8194ea21d1cfef5a72f757452.png[/img]

Over the past eight years, the situation has become very sad in those parts of the Rus lands controlled by the lizards - stinking oil fields, garbage dumps are spreading, uncontrolled construction and coal mining are flourishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/75cc8cc9b45f57a89a45f9018e6e749d59455479.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/c4c13eaf51f74ceb03d59d8f57a8a98f9eca4689.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/6f6690e1d4e200de4a7d94937f120841669589b0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/6544c1c542a369399dd3116b7828f09c416b7b54.png[/img]

The lizards now feel like the masters of these lands and are accumulating forces to finally expel the Slavs from their ancestral possessions.
You, our heroes, Vyacheslav, Vseslav, Viktor, and Mstislav, cannot allow this to happen.
Stop them!

notes.title: Playable characters of the game "Lizards Must Die 2"
notes.content:
The Rus brothers! It's time to introduce you to the main characters of [b]"Lizards Must Die 2"[/b]!

Choose your favorite fighter in the [i]COMMENTS[/i] ːberdysh_rusː ːberdysh_rusː ːberdysh_rusː
So, here they are, the [b]DEFENDERS OF THE [u]LANDS OF THE RUS[/u][/b]:
[h1]Drocheslav son of Sergey[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5b0e8849e032629ec4c0ccfaca1a13c95595f568.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Drocheslav son of Sergey[/b][/u] is a mighty warrior, son of Sergey and grandson of Perun, god of Thunder. Drocheslav is a testosterone rock that protects Land of the Rus from enemies all his life. Slow, but powerful and heavy, like a hammer blow to the balls.
He skillfully wields a two-handed axe, inflicts damage on the area and scatters lizards like babies. His patron is the mighty Perun, so Drocheslav can hit enemies not only with a axe swing, but also with lightningballs and thunder strikes.
[h1]Vseslav the Sorcerer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/0a6baf28e0c42452d5ddef79c0a11b7da29ad815.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Vseslav the Sorcerer[/b][/u] - Thomas Shelby, Sigma, Mafia. A sharp and impudent high-speed rus, he always speaks first and thinks later, so immediately, after he thinks, he is forced to fight. Vseslav is a Sorcerer, a descendant of an ancient Hyperborean princely family. He inherited a magic blade that can create copies of itself from his grandfather , and now destroys lizards with his dexterity and charisma.
[h1]Viktor Korneplod[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/6dba5a5f5a44478b61db6724bd08f5a3209fc74f.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Viktor Korneplod[/b][/u] is a hermit magus and an ancient Russian eco-activist. The damn lizards are polluting the lands of the Rus, and now Victor has a reason to come out of the thicket and unleash the fury of his staff on the heads of his enemies. The forces of nature, wind and earth are what the lizards who dare to desecrate the sacred forests will face. He prefers philosophical arguments with a badger, hedgehog or squirrel to the company of people.
[h1] Mstislav the Oaklover[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5d8369ee242ffd855af5d57d9ee80dc6c0f86e78.jpg[/img]
[u][b]Mstislav the Oaklover[/b][/u] - Oaklover was a nickname his parents gave him, though we will never know why, because Mstislav is an orphan. Fleeing from bears as a child, Mstislav hit his head on a rock and fell into Lake Baikal. After swimming in it for three days, he gained superpowers, but you have to pay for everything, so Mstislav is a bit slow-witted. Okay, to be honest, Mstislav is just dumb. Loves kvass. Doesn't like bears.

notes.title: Posters and Agitation in the RUS AND LIZARD Wars
notes.content:
Another batch of scientific documents came into our hands, which our team, of course, carefully examined and is now ready to present this scientific documents about our ancient history and the RUS' war with the LIZARDS.

"The leader of the lizards, Tsuk, having found out about the defeat of his troops, was furious, the foam of Baikal water appeared on the mouth of the bourgeois. He thought about the defeat, despite the fact that the Russ defeated only the vanguard, the lizards missed the opportunity to suddenly defeat the Russ. Zuk ordered to gather all his snake army, poison the blades with poison, and advance to Russia."

An excerpt from the chronicle of the history of the Ancient Rus. The year 1590 BC.

In the framework of countering the hordes of Herodian lizards, the leaders of the Rus resorted, among other things, to fine art. Propaganda posters and small caricatures, sketches were produced in order to kindle righteous anger towards the lizard tribe in the souls of ordinary Russians, or simply to inspire or cheer up the Heroes.

Unfortunately, these images have not reached our times, or have not been preserved, or the so-called official historiography has tried to hide it, so we asked our professional illustrator to study the documents we have collected bit by bit and restore the appearance of these images, which were so popular in Russia before our era.

The most frequently mentioned fragment in the sources is informing the RUS tribe about the lizard threat. Below you can see one of them, aimed primarily at identifying spies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/dabb4b9f6be4d9bb1db52670e2c2167f75e82fc0.jpg[/img]
[b]"YOU smell like a lizard"[/b]
[i]Rus looks at you as if you are a Lizard after all [/i]

There were also works aimed at promoting the culture of the ancient Slavs and promoting a healthy lifestyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/4f757e7e12435f135fff8df19c61a243224bd1a8.jpg[/img]
[b]"Stay hidrated with Baikalsk water"[/b]
[i]There is nothing tastier than Water from the Great Baikal[/i]

And there were also images and frescoes that seemed to say to the Lizard invaders - "Get out of our land, Foreign Herods, for GOOD." After all, nothing good was waiting for the tailed foreigners on the earth of the children of PERUN.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/6fa9caf978fb62a17bb5ebd4e454bfe880de9d04.jpg[/img]
[b]"Time to strangle the snake"[/b]
[i]And he strangled it![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/5edb4a53127b80b99e6f5c1836ed5016eab63ab1.jpg[/img]
[b]"Use your head If you decide to attack Baikalsk"[/b]
[i]He didn't think…[/i]

And, of course, the creations of ancient Slavic artists who raised the morale of the ancient Slavs, the children of SVAROG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44579280/7f7c62bdb54008b56c84587fdfd44dac5e1e4a67.jpg[/img]
[b]"Choose your weapon"[/b]
[i]Any means are good to beat the lizards!!![/i]

We would like to express our great gratitude to Alex ART for the talented reproduction of these ancient works!
